# GeoKnight GIS
> GeoKnight GIS (GeoKnight Geospatial Information Services), Jacksonville, Florida, builds custom GIS solutions for Florida businesses and local government: tailored maps, dashboards, data pipelines and 3D views, from address QC to parcel, roof-permit and flood-zone enrichment. Pricing: $95–$125/hr; Starter map $350; custom dashboard or tool $1,500–$5,000; data pipelines / integrations from $5,000; custom quotes by call. Founded by Christopher Knight, GIS & Data Engineer.
